style: Flat 2D illustration, a wide double-page spread from a children's picture book. {subject} No black outlines: shapes are flat colour fills only, every colour with a slightly darker flat shade for simple two-tone shading. Bright cheerful colours, clean simple shapes, lots of calm open space. No text, no letters, no numbers.

items.bg: A flat side view of a sunny prehistoric Australian outback like a stage set seen straight from the front with no perspective, with NO animals and NO people: a pale blue sky with a few soft white clouds, a big rounded red rock mountain far in the back, a few tall gum trees with pale trunks and grey green leaves at the left and right edges, a small blue waterhole, some round rocks, and a wide flat red orange earthy ground with dry yellow grass tufts across the whole bottom half of the picture.
